notes: Read all 303 source lines (numbered) before editing. The module is a keyboard-shortcut registry: a `useSyncExternalStore`-backed external store of ShortcutDefinitions plus a single delegated `keydown` listener on `document` that dispatches to the highest-priority matching entry for the active route. Three pieces are browser-only and ported behind native-safe facades per the established conventions (useKeyboardShortcuts globalThis keydown facade + capability gate; useFaviconBadge globalThis.document; RouteAnnouncer/RouteTransition/LegacyAlertRulesRedirect inject a `pathname` prop in place of react-router useLocation).

L2 `import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'` REMOVED — react-router-dom is browser-only and not a native dependency. Its single use (useActiveShortcuts L290 `useLocation()`) is replaced by an optional `pathname?: string` parameter on useActiveShortcuts (the RouteAnnouncer/RouteTransition pathname-prop precedent), falling back to a `globalThis.location.pathname` facade when omitted. reactRouterLocationAvailable:false recorded in nativeShortcutRegistryCapabilities.
